A New Journey

Welcome in {worldName}, {masterName}.

Explore the world, build yourself an empire, catch the most difficult Bestia.
The world ahead is yours to explore.

Good luck! You will need it.
Well met, traveller. I have nothing to offer you yet - come back once I do.
Where To Begin

Welcome traveller,

Since you are new to this world you need to learn the most basic skills first.
When you open your Skills window. The first entry there is [b]Basic Skill[/b].

How old is {place}?
The {civ} laid the first stones of {place} in {year}. We have been here ever since.
{place} goes back to {year}, when the {civ} came up the valley and stopped.
Why the walls?
{place} put its walls up in {year}. Nobody builds walls for the first fright.
Has {place} ever been taken?
The {civ} came through {place} in {year} and took what they liked.
{year}. The {civ} in the streets of {place}, and no help coming.
What became of {place}?
They pulled {place} down in {year}. Nothing was rebuilt.
Why did {place} empty out?
{place} emptied in {year}. People left one household at a time, and then there was nobody.
What happened at {place}?
The blight took the fields at {place}, and by {year} there was no reason left to stay.
What happened to {place}?
The mountain took {place} in {year}. You can still walk into what is left of it.
Ash. All of it, in one night, in {year}. {place} is under there somewhere.
Who are the {civ}?
The {civ} count their beginning from {year}, at {place}.
Whatever happened to the {civ}?
The {civ} came apart in {year}. There is nobody left to answer for them.
Has there been war?
The {civ} declared for war in {year}. It went on longer than anyone promised.
Any fighting near here?
The {civ} fought here in {year}. The ground still turns up iron.
{year}. A bad day for the {civ}, and a worse one for whoever was farming it.
Was {place} ever besieged?
The {civ} sat outside {place} through {year}, waiting for hunger to do the work.
Who holds {place} now?
The {civ} took {place} in {year}, and kept it.
Is there peace?
The {civ} signed in {year}. It has held, more or less.
Has sickness come through?
Plague in {place}, {year}. They burned the clothes and it went on spreading anyway.
{year} was the sickness. Ask anybody old enough and they will tell you who they lost.
Have the harvests ever failed?
{place} went hungry in {year}. Two bad harvests together is all it takes.
Does the water ever come up?
The water came into {place} in {year}. It has come close since, but not like that.
Is that mountain safe?
The mountain woke in {year}. Ash on everything for a season.
{year}. You could read by the light of it at midnight, and nobody slept.
Who leads the {civ}?
{figure} came up among the {civ} in {year}.
What became of {figure}?
{figure} of the {civ} died in {year}, in bed, which is more than most get.
How did {figure} die?
{figure} of the {civ} fell in battle in {year}.
Is the road safe?
{figure} of the {civ} went out into the waste in {year} and never came back.
{year}. {figure} took the short way across and is buried wherever they fell.
Did anyone go and look?
{figure} walked out to the wound in {year}. No grave, no word, nothing.
Is anything famous made near here?
{figure} made {artifact} in {year}.
Who carries {artifact}?
{artifact} passed to {figure} in {year}. Not everyone thought it should have.
Was anything ever lost near {place}?
Something went missing at {place} in {year} that people still come asking after.
Where did {artifact} end up?
{artifact} went into the ground with {figure} in {year}.
Is there anything worth digging for?
The {civ} opened the workings in {year}. It changed what this country is for.
Is there a house of the faith nearby?
The {civ} founded the house in {year}, somewhere poor and hard to reach, as they do.
Who watches the frontier?
The {civ} put a fort on the high ground in {year}.
What is the light on the headland?
The {civ} first lit it in {year}. It has not been dark since.
What is that stone for?
The {civ} raised it in {year}. Everybody argues about what it means.
Has anything changed in your lifetime?
The {civ} worked something new out in {year}, and the work has been easier since.
Where did the mana come from?
Something came down in {year}. Everything strange in this world starts there.
What is wrong with the land?
The corruption reached the fields at {place} in {year}. It does not go back.
Why is {place} still standing?
The {civ} raised wards at {place} in {year}. That is the only reason anybody is still there.
What do people here believe?
The {civ} swore themselves at {place} in {year}, and meant it.
Was there ever a falling out over it?
The {civ} broke with what they had sworn, at {place}, in {year}. It is still not forgiven.
What is the stone circle?
The {civ} raised it in {year}, to work at.
Do they still hold the rites?
The {civ} kept the rite at {place} in {year}. They keep it still, when it matters.
